newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Banco Finantia considers listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Banco Finantia considers listing - paper.

text.p: Portuguese investment bank Banco Finantia is considering being listed on Lisbon bourse, its president was quoted as saying.

Asked if the bank was considering applying to be listed, its president, Antonio Guerreiro, told Publico newspaper: "It is a matter which is being studied seriously. A decision will be taken by a general assembly."
He added: "No conclusion has yet been reached on this matter. When there is a conclusion, we will present it to the shareholders of the bank."
Asked if Banco Finantia could be listed this year, Guerreiro said: "That is not part of our plans. Maybe next year."
Guerreiro said a listing of Banco Finantia shares would boost the bank's access to capital, aiding its expansion plans, and increase the liquidity of its shares.
